newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Trust, Toyo Trust sag on financing plans.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Trust, Toyo Trust sag on financing plans.

text.p: Shares in Sumitomo Trust & Banking Co Ltd and Toyo Trust & Banking Co Ltd sagged on Tuesday morning, depressed by equity financing plans they announced on Monday, brokers said.
As of 0035 GMT, Sumitomo shares were down 30 yen at 1,040 and Toyo shares were down 14 yen at 810.
On Monday, Sumitomo Trust said it would issue up to 110 billion yen of yen-denominated subordinated convertible bonds through its wholly owned overseas unit STB Cayman Capital Ltd.
Toyo Trust said it would issue 50 billion yen of Euroyen subordinated bonds through its overseas unit and 50 billion yen of Euroyen convertible bonds.
